source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle, after one of its **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** models is allocated a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), this unit may summon its Watcher in the Dark. Through phase end, all its models gain [Feel No Pain](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain) 4+ for [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) only.
